bundle.shortDescription: PrimeBuild Official Store — Shopify admin console
bundle.longDescription: PrimeBuild Official Store is the official administration console for the PrimeBuild (primebuildfit) Shopify store: a read-only live view of the storefront (catalog, collections, orders, customers, discounts and the PB Coins rewards program). Independent app that belongs only to PrimeBuild — not CoinOS, PrimeBuild Internal OS, Eventra or Partnera. This desktop build runs the local server in a dedicated window and can rebuild itself automatically via the auto-rebuild pipeline.
